usage_notes: Advertised-only endpoint record from official OpenRouter docs and the public /api/v1/models catalog captured 2026-08-17; no controlled qualification observation has run against this endpoint yet.

OpenRouter is an aggregation broker: the endpoint operator and the declared upstream model vendor are distinct. By default it silently retries a different backing provider on 5xx/rate-limit; requests must carry provider.allow_fallbacks=false for exact-identity semantics.
Catalog suffixed identities (:nitro, :floor, :batch, -pro) are separate models and are not interchangeable with the exact slugs frozen here.
